mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.50% in the prior month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.50%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high housing starts and strong consumer credit, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as economic momentum peaks, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 480.0 and RSAFS > 380000.0), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior month indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 480,000 units in the prior month, it signals a potential housing market overheating that may trigger Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 480.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real consumer credit signals strong consumer spending that often precedes economic peak, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and rising RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
